## Context

The company needed to modernise a legacy backend that was hard to evolve.

## Problem

New requirements arrived faster than the old platform could absorb them.

## Solution

New services were added next to the legacy ones, using a strangler approach.

## My role

Software engineer on the delivery team, from API design to data modelling.

## Technical decisions

Python with FastAPI on AWS, Docker for packaging and a single deployment pipeline.

## Trade-offs

Two systems ran side by side for a while, which doubled the operational load.

## Impact

New features shipped without disrupting the systems the business used every day.

## What I'd do differently

I would write the migration plan earlier and share it with every team.
